Title: Canonical Task Lifecycle State Machine
Problem_Statement: Current execution states are loosely distributed between server jobs and orchestrator iterations without a formal unified lifecycle state machine.
Measurable_Acceptance_Criteria: Explicit state transitions (CREATED -> VALIDATING -> INGESTING -> PLANNING -> GENERATING_TESTS -> EXECUTING -> MUTATION_ANALYSIS -> EVALUATING -> COMPLETED; FAILED, CANCELLED, TIMED_OUT, RECOVERING); idempotent state updates; duration metrics per stage.

Title: End-to-End Agent Coordination with Real MCP Invocation
Problem_Statement: MCP tools are currently registered and verified via unit tests and UI modal but are not dynamically invoked during the agentic test generation loop.
Measurable_Acceptance_Criteria: Orchestrator invokes real FastMCP tool (e.g. read_text_file, get_file_info) during planning/ingestion stage; tool parameters and return values validated via Pydantic; tool errors captured safely.

Title: Deterministic Checkpoint Recovery & Safe Resumption
Problem_Statement: Checkpoints are stored in SQLite and can be manually inspected or restored in UI but the agent loop does not automatically resume an interrupted multi-cycle task from the last valid checkpoint.
Measurable_Acceptance_Criteria: Task reaches checkpoint -> interrupted via controlled cancellation or failure -> resumes from stage checkpoint without repeating previously killed mutants; final report flags recovered stages.

Title: Diverse Evaluation Corpus with Defect Injection
Problem_Statement: Current sample tests primarily focus on discount.py and banking.py; broader coverage of complex algorithmic patterns is needed for convincing viva evaluation.
Measurable_Acceptance_Criteria: Evaluation corpus manifest with 5 diverse real-world modules (state machine, rate limiter, inventory pricing, banking, currency); documented defect injection manifests for each module.

Title: Multi-Run Empirical Testing Strategy Comparison
Problem_Statement: Benchmarking currently relies heavily on single baseline or fast simulated offline runs; statistical multi-run evaluations with explicit variance are needed.
Measurable_Acceptance_Criteria: Compare Baseline vs Zero-Shot vs Multi-Agent Reflection across corpus; report mean and standard deviation for score, duration, iterations; clear separation of live model tokens vs offline simulation.

Title: Adversarial Resilience & Execution Sandbox Guardrails
Problem_Statement: Subprocess execution relies on OS process limits (RLIMIT_AS) and basic AST filtering; comprehensive threat modeling and negative testing are needed.
Measurable_Acceptance_Criteria: Threat model document; security test matrix testing prompt injection in docstrings, path traversal, socket creation, memory exhaustion; explicit SecurityRefusal fail-closed behavior.

Title: Full End-to-End Lineage Observability & WebSocket Backpressure
Problem_Statement: Trace logger records events but complete causal DAG linking test generation to specific mutation failures needs explicit visualization; WebSocket needs slow consumer testing.
Measurable_Acceptance_Criteria: Provenance trace linking mutant_id to parent event; WebSocket hub tested with bounded queue drop-oldest under slow consumer; distinct dispatch latency vs client round-trip latency.

Title: Automated CI/CD Workflow with Security & Docker Verification
Problem_Statement: No standardized GitHub Actions CI workflow exists in the repository for pull request verification.
Measurable_Acceptance_Criteria: GitHub Actions workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) testing Python 3.13, pip check, compileall, pytest suite, security tests, and Docker build without publishing secrets.

Title: Deterministic Offline Evaluator Walkthrough & Viva Runbook
Problem_Statement: Examiners require a reliable 5-minute demonstration that does not depend on live cloud internet
Risk_Reduction: Complete self-contained demo script with local fixture containing a known defect, demonstrating ingestion, planning, MCP tool call, mutation detection, simulated interruption, and recovery.
